source.description: A reviewed six-panel raster contact sheet showing one consistent cheetah-print pattern progressing from pale pencil rhythm guides to thick black felt-tip spots and natural golden-ochre marker color.
source.notes: The process must keep the same full-page crop of irregular solid cheetah spots. Cheetah markings are solid spots, never leopard-style rosettes. The lesson draws only the pattern, not an animal, sticker, badge, fabric product, border, face, text, or final-only motif. A first generated sheet with rosettes is preserved privately and rejected for species inaccuracy.

process_strategy: Establish one diagonal pattern flow and every large solid-spot position before inking or coloring, then add smaller filler spots, varied black marker weights, and natural marker fill cumulatively so the final only evens existing marks.

final_elements.name: diagonal flow guides and motif centers
final_elements.description: Three faint sweeping diagonal rhythm bands with varied centers for the larger solid spots across the same square crop.

final_elements.name: large irregular solid-spot shapes
final_elements.description: A loose field of uneven round, oval, and slightly angular solid-spot outlines distributed along the guides without rings or open centers.

final_elements.name: small filler spots and clipped edge spots
final_elements.description: Smaller solid-spot outlines in the remaining negative spaces plus a few partial spots clipped naturally by the crop edges.

final_elements.name: thick black marker spot weights
final_elements.description: Handmade thick black felt-tip fill inside every established large, small, and edge-clipped spot while preserving uneven hand-drawn edges.

final_elements.name: golden-ochre and warm-tan marker color
final_elements.description: Golden-ochre marker around the black spots with broad warm-tan variation, visible directional streaks, and small intentional paper highlights.

frames.visible_job: Places three pale diagonal rhythm bands and varied centers for the larger solid spots across one fixed square crop.
introduces: diagonal flow guides and motif centers

frames.visible_job: Builds uneven round, oval, and slightly angular spot outlines around the established motif centers, with no rings or open rosette centers.
requires_prior_elements: diagonal flow guides and motif centers

frames.visible_job: Adds smaller solid-spot outlines in the open spaces and a few partial spots clipped by the crop edges without moving the established large spots.
introduces: small filler spots and clipped edge spots

frames.visible_job: Fills every existing large, small, and edge-clipped spot with imperfect black felt-tip weight while preserving irregular hand-drawn edges.
requires_prior_elements: small filler spots and clipped edge spots

frames.visible_job: Pulls golden-ochre and warm-tan marker strokes around the existing black motifs, following the diagonal flow and leaving small paper highlight gaps.

final_step.visible_job: Only strengthens the established black solid spots, golden-ochre and warm-tan fills, diagonal rhythm, and intentional paper gaps.
allowed_changes: black marker-fill evening inside existing motifs
natural marker-fill evening around existing motifs

rejection_checks: The same square crop, diagonal flow, motif positions, and spacing must persist in all six panels.
Every large, small, and edge-clipped solid spot must appear before the final panel and persist through the finish; no ringed or open-center leopard rosette is allowed.
No animal, face, fabric product, sticker outline, badge frame, decorative border, text, extra motif, or final-only color area may appear.
The finish must show handmade marker streaks and irregular spot edges rather than seamless digital texture or clean vector-pattern polish, and no adjacent frame may look unchanged at card size.
